name: pepper-sast
description: Pepper security findings (AI SAST, secrets, logic flaws) in the editor: diagnostics, details on hover, rescans and an instant check on save.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Pepper does not run git or send file contents.

pepper.serverUrl.description: Your Pepper server (sast.votal.ai or your on-prem URL). Must be https:// except for localhost.

pepper.minSeverity.description: Lowest severity shown in the editor.

pepper.checkOnSave.description: Check a file for secrets and risky patterns when it is saved (sends the saved file to your Pepper server; no AI).

pepper.branch.description: Show findings from this branch's latest scan. Empty: the current git branch, falling back to the repository's latest scan.

pepper.refreshMinutes.description: Refresh findings in the background every N minutes (0 turns it off).

pepper.caFile.description: PEM file with your organization's CA certificate, for an on-prem server with an internal certificate.

scripts.package: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','LICENSE')" && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out pepper-sast.vsix
